thread:
Anya: quick heads-up — night change window tonight 23:00-02:00 PST. We'll run a canary for the new routing-policy + model v2.3 (pin). Deploy-bot scheduled at 23:05. No non-critical merges after 20:00. @Marta @Samir @Ops-Jen please confirm rollback thresholds and who owns smoke.
Marta: ack. I'll run staging smoke at 19:30 and a sandbox dry-run of the canary at 21:00. Monitoring: p95 latency, 5xx rate, trace error rate, and tail token latency.
Samir: propose rollback triggers: >3% service_error rate OR p95 latency increase >30% vs baseline sustained for 10m OR request-drop rate >5% in two consecutive 5m windows. Auto-fallback to v2.2 pinned variant and route traffic to reserved pool.
deploy-bot: scheduled: canary start=23:05; stages=[5%,20%,60%]; step_delay=10m; rollback_conditions=[service_errors>3% for 10m, p95>500ms for 10m]; auto-fallback=enabled; post-status=in-thread.
Ops-Jen: please ensure capacity reservation is active and disable scale-burst for the night window. Suppress noisy alerts to only #eng-oncall and #product; non-critical alerts muted :mute:. I'll prepare a one-click rollback.
Leo: where are the release notes? Need a short blurb for support and product.
Anya: draft release notes here: https://internal.redwood/notes/night-canary-v2.3 (will update after preflight). Key bullets: routing-policy tweak, model pin to v2.3, fallback path to v2.2, no schema changes.
Marta: adding a "silent-mode" for this window — only critical alerts and incidentbot pings. Plan to push silent-mode at 22:50.
Samir: config I plan to use for deploy-bot (for visibility):
```
canary:
  stages: [5,20,60]
  step_delay: 600  # seconds
  rollback:
    - metric: service_errors
      threshold_pct: 3
      window: 600
    - metric: p95_latency
      threshold_ms: 500
      window: 600
  fallback: v2.2
  notify: [#eng-oncall, @Samir, @Ops-Jen]
```
Marta: copied. Ops will run smoke at 19:30, sandbox canary at 21:00, final ready-check at 22:45. @Samir you'll own the rollback decision if thresholds hit?
Samir: yes, I'll call rollback. If I don't respond within 3 minutes of an automated alert, Ops-Jen is authorized to execute rollback.
Ops-Jen: noted. I'll prepare the rollback playbook and test the one-click rollback link now. Also will pin capacity and confirm autoscale is disabled for the window.
Leo: ack, I'll post the support blurb and link to the release notes once Anya updates.
Anya: thanks — please react with :white_check_mark: once you've completed your pre-flight tasks.
Marta: :white_check_mark:
Samir: :white_check_mark:
Ops-Jen: :white_check_mark:
Leo: :white_check_mark:
deploy-bot: noted — canary scheduled and will post stage updates and any rollback reasons in this thread.
Anya: final reminder: no schema changes allowed, no model weight swaps without canary, and keep this thread as single source of truth for status updates. If anything looks off, escalate to #incident immediately.
